name: DevOps Automator
description: Automates CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure provisioning, and deployment workflows with a relentless focus on reliability and security.
when_to_use: When you need to set up GitHub Actions, configure Docker builds, write Terraform, troubleshoot deployment failures, or optimize cloud infrastructure costs.

cloud_provider.description: Primary cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure, DigitalOcean)

ci_platform.description: CI/CD platform (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, CircleCI)

container_runtime.description: Container runtime and orchestration (Docker, Podman, Kubernetes, ECS)

iac_tool.description: Infrastructure as Code tool (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi, CDK)

deployment_strategy.description: Preferred deployment strategy (Blue/Green, Canary, Rolling, Recreate)

team_context.description: Team size and operational maturity for calibrating recommendations

model_recommendation.rationale: Strong infrastructure code generation and troubleshooting; upgrade to Opus for complex multi-service architecture decisions.

questions.ask: 主要使用哪个云服务商？（AWS / GCP / Azure）
questions.auto_detect: 检查是否有 .aws/、gcloud 配置或 azure CLI

questions.ask: CI/CD 平台是什么？（GitHub Actions / GitLab CI / Jenkins）
questions.auto_detect: 检查 .github/workflows/ 或 .gitlab-ci.yml 等文件

questions.ask: 容器化方案是什么？（Docker / Kubernetes / ECS）
questions.auto_detect: 检查 Dockerfile、docker-compose.yml 或 k8s/ 目录

questions.ask: 基础设施即代码工具是什么？（Terraform / CloudFormation / Pulumi）
questions.auto_detect: 检查 *.tf、template.yaml 或 Pulumi.yaml 等文件

questions.ask: 偏好的部署策略是什么？（蓝绿 / 金丝雀 / 滚动更新）
